title: Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.51 fails to launch
body:
## Bug Description

Claude Code for VS Code extension version **2.1.51** fails to start/run entirely.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Install Claude Code for VS Code extension version 2.1.51
2. Attempt to launch/use the extension
3. Extension does not run

## Expected Behavior

The extension should start and function normally.

## Actual Behavior

The extension fails to launch completely. No functionality is available.

## Workaround

Downgrading to a previous version of the extension resolves the issue and allows it to function normally.

## Environment

- **OS**: Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19045
- **Extension Version**: 2.1.51 (broken), previous version (works)
- **IDE**: VS Code
